source.title: Small-molecule inhibition of kinesin KIF18A reveals a mitotic vulnerability enriched in chromosomally unstable cancers

assessment: Four distinct research compounds; retain measured cancer-cell and mouse tumor responses with model-specific normal-cell observations. BUBR1 restoration, faithful division and MVA muscle efficacy remain unestablished.

reading_depth.root: Main, complete Results, Discussion and main/extended figure legends read through primary Europe PMC XML.
reading_depth.second_reader: Complete Methods, MathML endpoint definitions, ethics/conflicts and Figures3/5/6 legends audited independently.
reading_depth.limits: Original figures not obtained through normal accessible routes. Numerical values are reported text/legend values, not independent image measurements.

compound_identity.name: AM-0277
compound_identity.role: Distinct early cellular compound; no mouse efficacy assigned

identity_limits: Current indexed manufacturer catalog identity only; direct opens403. No authenticated study-equivalent lot, stock or clinical approval claim. Do not equate separate stereoisomers or other KIF18A programs.
bubr1_endpoint: OVCAR-3 AM-0277 mitotic time-course doublets/arrest-associated state, one experiment; no usable-protein abundance, half-life or actual-allele rescue result.
normal_tissue_limits: Selected healthy marrow donors, fibroblast/epithelial/T-cell assays and24h sensory-neurosphere neurites. Limited mouse weight/blood-count observations. No constitutional BUB1B-deficient tissue or long-term pediatric safety. AM-5308/9022 marrow n=2 donors, AM-0277/1882 n=4. OVCAR-3 AM-1882/5308 blood-count subgroup n=6 per arm; platelet data unavailable.

tumor_endpoints.regression_formula: 100 - 100 * treated final group-mean volume / treated initial group-mean volume
tumor_endpoints.growth_inhibition_formula: 100 - 100 * change in treated group-mean volume / change in control group-mean volume
tumor_endpoints.not_equivalent: Neither is a clinical response probability. No measurable tumor is not proven eradication.

model_limits: Immunodeficient female athymic nude or CB.17 SCID xenografts; no established intact tumor surveillance. No sample-size calculation; Amgen studies unblinded; predominantly company-employed/shareholding authors.
comparison: Retain a tumor-research route; no displacement of the provisional niacin/restoration or apitegromab/compensation comparison. Neither nominee demonstrates MVA efficacy.
existing_additional_source: pubmed-supplement-review.md already qualifies a separate AM-9022 SCLC study; not re-read or credited as a new full-paper study here.

independent_methods_audit.scope: Complete Methods including display equations; ethics, authors, contributions/conflicts; full Fig3/5/6 legends and bounded Results sections5/7/8. No original figure image inspection, no whole-paper/supplement qualification.
independent_methods_audit.image_retrieval_status: unavailable after ordinary official OA API route; not visually inspected
material_corrections: Athymic nude and CB.17 SCID, not NOD/SCID.
PDX Methods >=27 days versus Results/legend >=28 days; retain day27 stop and exact follow-up.
TGI, TR and tumor-free are distinct; tumor-free means no measurable tumor.
AM-5308/AM-9022 marrow assays used two donors each; no universal safety conclusion.
Platelet counts unavailable because of processing problems.

duration_discrepancy: PDX Methods says daily >=27 consecutive days; Results/legend says >=28. CTG-0017/-0437 stop day27, observe to58/34. CTG-0888 dosing to43, last measurement41; CTG-1019 dosing to52, last measurement51. No forced reconciliation.
